label: radeon-vllm-qwen3-8b-nothink
platform: vLLM 0.16.1.dev0 on ROCm 7.2.1 (navi, ubuntu22.04, torch 2.9), AMD Radeon Cloud

measurement.method: measured from the client over the Radeon Cloud HTTPS spaces proxy; the instance SSH port is refused from the client network and the Jupyter port returns 403, so no on-box run was possible
measurement.rtt_note: this round-trip is included in every ttft_s_median below; GPU-side TTFT is approximately ttft minus rtt
measurement.unit_note: chunks_per_s counts streamed SSE content deltas, not tokenizer tokens; deltas can coalesce in transit so this is a slight undercount
